name: artemis
description: A local-first cross-platform desktop coding agent powered by Pi.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @artemis/desktop
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @artemis/protocol && npm run build -w @artemis/platform && npm run build -w @artemis/agent-host
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @artemis/desktop
scripts.verify:screenshot-matrix: npm run build:core && npm run verify:screenshot-matrix -w @artemis/desktop
scripts.verify:goal-parity: npm run build:core && npm run verify:goal-parity -w @artemis/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @artemis/protocol && npm run test -w @artemis/platform && npm run test -w @artemis/agent-host && npm run test -w @artemis/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @artemis/desktop
